reference.question: In square \(ABCD\), extend \(BC\) to point \(E\) so that \(CE=AC\), and join \(AE\). Find the measure of \(\angle E\). (Unit: degrees.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use the isosceles triangle

\(\angle ACB=45^\circ\), so \(\angle ACE=135^\circ\). Since \(CA=CE\), \(\angle E=(180^\circ-135^\circ)\div2=22.5^\circ\).
